nom: Charlotte Tilbury Magic Water Cream Gel Moisturizer with Niacinamide

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some in dry climates or going through menopause, report strong hydration, softer skin, and reduced dry patches, though one reviewer notes the formula may not be enough for chronically dry skin and prefers layering something richer.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including a couple with reactive or rosacea-adjacent redness, report no irritation and calmer, less red skin, but two reviewers with sensitive or dry-sensitive skin describe a burning sensation or irritation that made them stop using it.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin describe the gel as lightweight and non-greasy, with one saying it helps with oil control.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it hydrates without adding oiliness or shine, working well in the T-zone.
segments.normal: A couple of reviewers describe the formula as suited to normal-to-combination or normal-to-dry skin, delivering hydration without a heavy feel.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers mention fine lines, with one saying the cream lessens their appearance, while a couple of others say they have not noticed a significant change in wrinkles despite wanting to.
concerns.dehydration: The great majority of reviewers describe strong, all-day hydration and a dewy, plump look; a minority found it too thick, too light for their needs, or slow to absorb.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness or a calming effect, including two with sensitive or reactive skin; one reviewer had the opposite experience, describing a burning sensation that left her skin irritated.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some with sensitive or breakout-prone skin, report the cream does not cause breakouts and even improved on a previous, heavier product that did; one reviewer describes a severe breakout after a single use.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers describe the cream leaving skin looking shiny or oily, especially when layered over other products, while others with oily or combination skin say it stays lightweight and matte-leaning.

aspects.libelle: Can feel oily when layered with other products

extraits.texte: On the first and only try after putting it on,I felt a burning sensation and left my skin irritated.

I received this free from Charlotte Tilbury for my honest review. I have dry, very sensitive skin. When I first put this on my skin was glowing. After a few minutes it started to irritate my skin and I had to wash it off. Sadly this particular product was not for me.

extraits.titre: Slightly misleading and doesn't layer well
extraits.texte: Was excited to try this because I LOVE water and gel moisturizers when they work as promised. Unfortunately when I opened the jar this didn't really look like a water cream and is a thicker consistency that looks only slightly thinner than the OG Magic Cream, so that disappointed me but I still tried it in a few ways. I layer a few serums in my skincare routine and during the day I typically can't use more than a water cream otherwise my face is left too oily/dewy. I used this after the Magic Serum and a niacinimide and ceramide serum and typically my skin has a bit of a glow but this left it incredibly shiny/oily looking, almost like the cream has some mica in it. I had to powder my face even after using my mattifying SPF which typically isn't something I need to do. I did try this cream on its own and my skin did absorb it better, but it took a solid 30 minutes. I found it worked great under makeup as a first step before primer and my foundation looked great! But for daily skincare needs this doesn't have enough benefits for me to use with nothing else, so I can't really justify the price or plan to purchase this in the future. If you have drier skin this may be helpful for you though.

I have dry skin and currently living in a dry climate as well. Ive tried the normal magic cream and it has vegetable oil, fragrance, just a lot of junk. Especially when my forehead can get closed comedones and breakouts easily. I took a gamble and bought the mini and fell in loveee!!! I am so dry in some areas i often peel, so i was prepared to give this away or return (i cant do gel or gel creams becuase of my dry skin). But i was so shocked at how hydrating this is and it make my skin so shiny and glowy and layers so beautifully under makeup. As a sensitive skin girly too, fragrance free is so important to me as fragrances can be irritating. Also, CT is certified cruelty free by leaping bunny, as a girl who lovess animals and only shops cruelty free, so important! Ive since bought the water cream set with the full size and mini that's on the way and I can't wait! Just try it!

extraits.titre: A High Quality Moisturizer For Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: Okay, so I've been using this new Charlotte Tilbury moisturizer called Magic Water Cream, and it's the real deal. I have dry, sensitive skin, and this stuff is a lifesaver. At first, I was like, "No way, this is too light," but it's super hydrating. It's like a drink of water for my skin, but without the feeling of greasy residue. I use it with the Magic Serum Crystal Elixir, and my skin feels like a dream. My redness is way down, and my skin texture is smoother than ever. Plus, it doesn't make my T-zone oily, which is a huge win. I've tried a ton of moisturizers, but this one is the best. It's gentle enough for sensitive skin, but it still provides the hydration my skin needs. And the best part? It doesn't have a strong fragrance, which can be irritating for those of us with sensitive skin. One thing I really appreciate about Magic Water Cream is that it helps my makeup apply more smoothly. My foundation looks flawless, and my pores appear smaller. I used to struggle with redness and uneven skin tone, but this moisturizer has made a significant difference. The packaging is also a plus. The glass jar is elegant and feels luxurious, and the lid is easy to twist off and on. While it might not be the most eco-friendly option, it's a small price to pay for such a great product. I've been using Magic Water Cream for a few weeks now, and I've already noticed a noticeable improvement in my skin. Great product! Good no smell and no reaction on sensitive skin. It also works really well on my oily skin! Packaging is easy to open. Would recommend !

Charlotte's Magic Water Cream is a refreshing and lightweight moisturizer that provides a burst of hydration without feeling heavy or greasy. The gel-like texture instantly melts into the skin, leaving it feeling smooth, plump, and dewy. It's perfect for those with oily or combination skin, as it delivers moisture without clogging pores or adding excess shine. One of the standout features is the inclusion of hyaluronic acid and plant extracts, which help lock in moisture and give the skin a healthy glow. After using it for a few weeks, my skin felt more balanced and hydrated, with a noticeable improvement in texture. It is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a hydrating, lightweight moisturizer that absorbs quickly and leaves your skin glowing. It's perfect for daily use and works well under makeup.
